description: Published systematic-strategy candidates, screened against Poseidon's own data capabilities and tradeable universe. Reported metrics are the source papers' own published figures, not Poseidon backtests.
provenance: Strategy names, reported Sharpe/volatility/rebalance cadence and paper URLs are factual attributes of published academic work, collected via the paperswithbacktest/awesome-systematic-trading index. No code from that repository is used or derived here; the feasibility screen, capability mapping and record structure are Poseidon's own.
